decision.explanation: The 2020 British Open golf tournament was canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic according to both D2S2 and D3S2. This directly supports the claim that there was no winner in 2020. The reference to 'Collin Morikawa' in D1S1 appears to describe a different event (likely the 2020 U.S. Open) and is not relevant to the British Open in 2020.
